diff --git "[FORUM_EXT]/phpbbgallery\\core/styles/FLATBOOTS/template/gallery/album_body.html" "[FORUM_EXT]/phpbbgallery\\core/styles/FLATBOOTS/template/gallery/album_body.html"
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ "[FORUM_EXT]/phpbbgallery\\core/styles/FLATBOOTS/template/gallery/album_body.html"
@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+<!-- INCLUDE gallery/gallery_header.html -->
+
+<div class="side-segment">
+	<h3><a href="{U_VIEW_ALBUM}">{ALBUM_NAME}</a></h3>
+	<!-- IF ALBUM_DESC --><h4><i class="fa fa-caret-right"></i> {ALBUM_DESC} </h4><!-- ENDIF -->
+</div>
+<div class="space10"></div>
+<div class="clearfix">
+<!-- IF not S_IN_GALLERY_POPUP -->
+	<div class="pull-left">
+		<div class="btn-group">
+		    <div class="dropdown">
+		       <a title="" data-original-title="" class="btn btn-small btn-default" data-toggle="dropdown" href="#"><i class="fa fa-folder"></i> Manage <span class="caret"></span></a>
+		            <ul class="dropdown-menu">

+<!-- INCLUDE gallery/gallery_header.html -->
+
+<div class="side-segment"><h3><a href="{U_VIEW_IMAGE}">{IMAGE_NAME}</a></h3></div>
+
+<!-- IF U_IMAGE -->
+<div class="well text-center">

+</div>
+<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+<form id="postform" action="{S_ALBUM_ACTION}" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">

+		<div class="side-segment"><h3>{L_POST_COMMENT}</h3></div>
+		<fieldset>
+			<!-- IF ERROR --><p class="error">{ERROR}</p><!-- ENDIF -->
+
+			<!-- IF not S_USER_LOGGED_IN -->
+				<label for="username">{L_USERNAME}{L_COLON}</label>
+				<input class="form-control" type="text" tabindex="1" name="username" value="{USERNAME}" size="60" maxlength="32" />
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+			
+			<!-- IF S_ALLOWED_TO_RATE -->
+					<label>{L_YOUR_RATING}{L_COLON}</label>
+					<!-- IF .rate_scale -->
+						<select class="selectpicker show-tick" data-container="body" data-width="86px" data-style="btn btn-sm btn-default" name="rating">
+						<!-- BEGIN rate_scale -->
+							<!-- IF rate_scale.RATE_POINT == 1 --><option value="0">{L_DONT_RATE_IMAGE}</option><!-- ENDIF -->
+							<option value="{rate_scale.RATE_POINT}">{rate_scale.RATE_POINT}</option>
+						<!-- END rate_scale -->
+						</select>
+					<!-- ELSE -->
+						{CONTEST_RATING}
+					<!-- ENDIF -->
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+			<!-- IF CAPTCHA_TEMPLATE -->
+				<!-- INCLUDE {CAPTCHA_TEMPLATE} -->
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+			<label for="message">{L_YOUR_COMMENT}{L_COLON}</label>
+
+			<!-- INCLUDE posting_buttons.html -->
+
+			<div class="space10"></div>
+				
+			<div class="row">
+				<div class="col-md-8"> 
+				<div id="message-box">
+				 <textarea class="form-control" name="message" id="message" rows="10" tabindex="3" onselect="storeCaret(this);" onclick="storeCaret(this);" onkeyup="storeCaret(this);">{MESSAGE}</textarea>
+
+				<small class="pull-right">{L_COMMENT_LENGTH}</small>
+				</div>
+				</div>

+				<div class="col-md-4">

+						<!-- END smiley -->
+					<!-- ENDIF -->
+					<!-- IF S_SHOW_SMILEY_LINK and S_SMILIES_ALLOWED-->

+						{FLASH_STATUS}&#44;
+						{URL_STATUS}&#44;
+					<!-- ENDIF -->
+					{SMILIES_STATUS}
+					<!-- ENDIF -->
+					<hr />
+				 <input type="checkbox" name="attach_sig" id="attach_sig" {S_SIGNATURE_CHECKED}><label for="attach_sig">{L_ATTACH_SIG}</label>
+				</div>
+			</div>
+
+		</fieldset>
+	</div>
+</div>
+
+	<fieldset class="form-actions">
+		{S_HIDDEN_FIELDS}{S_CAPTCHA_HIDDEN_FIELDS}

+		<button type="submit" accesskey="s" tabindex="201" class="btn btn-default start" data-loading-text="Loading...<i class='icon-spin icon-spinner icon-large icon-white'></i>" value="{L_SUBMIT}" name="submit">{L_SUBMIT}</button>

+</form>

+$(document).ready(function() {
+	/**
+	 * Function to resize albums
+	 */
+	function resize() {
+		$('.albums').each(function() {
+			var $this = $(this),
+				albums = $this.children(),
+				maxWidth = Math.floor($this.width()),
+				lastPosition = 0,
+				lastRow = [],
+				maxHeight = 0,
+				nextPosition = 0;
+
+			// Reset all albums
+			albums.removeClass('first-item').css('min-height', '');
+
+			albums.each(function(i) {
+				var item = $(this),
+					left = Math.floor(item.offset().left);
+
+				if (i > 0 && left <= nextPosition) {
+					// Align last row
+					if (lastRow.length) {
+						albums.filter(lastRow.join(',')).css('min-height', maxHeight + 'px');
+					}
+
+					// Clear row
+					item.addClass('first-item');
+
+					// Reset counters
+					left = 0;
+					lastFirst = i;
+					maxHeight = 0;
+					lastRow = [];
+				}
+
+				lastRow.push(':nth-child(' + (i + 1) + ')');
+				lastPosition = left;
+				nextPosition = left + item.width() - 1;
+				maxHeight = Math.max(maxHeight, item.height());	
+			});
+		});
+	}
+	resize();
+	$(window).resize(resize);
+});

+<!-- INCLUDE gallery/gallery_header.html -->

+			<!-- IF not S_USER_LOGGED_IN -->

+				</dl>
+			<!-- ENDIF -->

+			</dl>
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+			<!-- IF S_SMILIES_ALLOWED and .smiley -->

+					<dt><label>{L_SMILIES}{L_COLON}</label></dt>
+					<dd><!-- BEGIN smiley --><a href="#" onclick="insert_text('{smiley.A_SMILEY_CODE}', true); return false;"><img src="{smiley.SMILEY_IMG}" width="{smiley.SMILEY_WIDTH}" height="{smiley.SMILEY_HEIGHT}" alt="{smiley.SMILEY_CODE}" title="{smiley.SMILEY_DESC}" /></a> <!-- END smiley --></dd>
+					<!-- IF S_SHOW_SMILEY_LINK and S_SMILIES_ALLOWED--><dd><a href="{U_MORE_SMILIES}" onclick="gallery_popup(this.href, 300, 350, '_phpbbsmilies'); return false;">{L_MORE_SMILIES}</a></dd><!-- ENDIF -->
+				</dl>
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+			<!-- BEGIN image -->
+				<hr />
+				<div class="clearfix">
+					<label class="control-label" for="image_name_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}">{L_IMAGE_NAME}{L_COLON}</label><!-- IF image.S_FIRST_ROW and (NUM_IMAGES > 1) --><input type="checkbox" name="same_name" id="same_name" value="1" onchange="change_read_write();" /> <label for="same_name">{L_USE_SAME_NAME}</label><!-- ENDIF -->
+					<!-- IF image.S_FIRST_ROW and (NUM_IMAGES > 1) -->
+						<dd class="simulate-dd"><input type="checkbox" name="same_name" id="same_name" value="1" onchange="change_read_write();" /> <label for="same_name">{L_USE_SAME_NAME}</label></dd>
+						
+					<!-- ENDIF -->
+					
+					<!-- IF image.S_FIRST_ROW and (NUM_IMAGES > 1) -->
+					<div class="space10"></div>	
+						<div class="controls controls-row">

+							<input class="form-control" type="text" id="image_num" name="image_num" onchange="update_all('image_name'); update_all('message');" onkeyup="update_all('image_name'); update_all('message');" value="1">
+					</div>
+					<!-- ENDIF -->
+					
+					<div class="controls controls-row"> 
+						<input class="form-control" type="text" tabindex="1{image.S_ROW_COUNT}" id="image_name_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}" name="image_name[{image.S_ROW_COUNT}]" value="{image.IMAGE_NAME}"<!-- IF image.S_FIRST_ROW --> onchange="update_all('image_name');" onselect="update_all('image_name');" onclick="update_all('image_name');" onkeyup="update_all('image_name');"<!-- ENDIF --> size="60" maxlength="128" />

+						   <span id="desc_length_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}">{L_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH}</span>

+							<div class="radio"><input type="radio" name="rotate[{image.S_ROW_COUNT}]" id="rotate_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}_270" value="270" /> <label for="rotate_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}_270">{L_ROTATE_RIGHT}</label></div>
+							<div class="radio"><input type="radio" name="rotate[{image.S_ROW_COUNT}]" id="rotate_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}_180" value="180" /> <label for="rotate_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}_180">{L_ROTATE_UPSIDEDOWN}</label></div>

+

+				</dl>

+				</dl>

+</div>
+<!-- ENDIF -->

+<!-- IF S_AJAX_REQUEST -->

+		</select></label>
+
+		<label><strong>{L_MORE_INFO}{L_COLON}</strong><br /><span>{L_CAN_LEAVE_BLANK}</span>
+			<textarea class="inputbox" name="reason" id="reason" rows="4" cols="40">{REASON}</textarea>
+		</label>
+	<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+	<fieldset class="submit-buttons">
+		<input type="button" name="confirm" value="{YES_VALUE}" class="button1 btn btn-default" />&nbsp;
+		<input type="button" name="cancel" value="{L_NO}" class="button2 btn btn-default" />
+	</fieldset>
+
+<!-- ELSE -->
+
+<!-- INCLUDE overall_header.html -->

+

+		<fieldset>

+			</dl>

+

+

+
+	<!-- IF S_GALLERY_MCP_VIEWALBUM or S_QUEUE_LIST or S_REPORT_LIST -->

+			  {DESCRIPTION}
+			</div>
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+			<form method="post" id="mcp" action="{S_MCP_ACTION}">

+	<div class="panel panel-default">

+				<th class="large-gallery" data-class="expand"><i class="fa fa-picture-o"></i> {L_IMAGES}</th>

+				<!-- IF S_REPORTER --><th data-hide="phone"><i class="fa fa-info-sign"></i> {L_REPORTER_AND_ALBUM}</th><!-- ENDIF -->

+				<!-- IF S_MARK --><th data-hide="phone"><i class="fa fa-check-o"></i> {L_MARK}</th><!-- ENDIF -->
+			</tr>
+		</thead>
+		<tbody>
+				<!-- BEGIN image_row -->	
+			<tr>
+				<td>

+						<a href="<!-- IF not S_REPORT -->{image_row.U_IMAGE_PAGE}<!-- ELSE -->{image_row.U_REPORT}<!-- ENDIF -->" class="topictitle">{image_row.IMAGE_NAME}</a>
+						<!-- IF image_row.S_REPORTED --> <a href="{image_row.U_REPORT}" rel="tooltip" data-placement="right" title="The image was reported"><i class="icon-exclamation-sign muted"></i></a><!-- ENDIF -->
+						<!-- IF image_row.S_UNAPPROVED --> <a href="{image_row.U_QUEUE}" rel="tooltip" data-placement="right" title="The image is awaiting for approval"><i class="icon-question-sign muted"></i></a><!-- ENDIF -->
+						<br />
+						
+						<i class="fa fa-user"></i> {L_POST_BY_AUTHOR} {image_row.UPLOADER}<br />
+						 <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i> {image_row.IMAGE_TIME}
+					<!-- IF image_row.REPORT_MOD --><br />{L_REPORT_MOD} {image_row.REPORT_MOD}<!-- ENDIF -->
+				</td>
+				    <!-- IF S_COMMENTS --><td>{image_row.COMMENTS}</td><!-- ENDIF -->
+				    <!-- IF S_RATINGS --><td>{image_row.RATING}</td><!-- ENDIF -->
+					<!-- IF S_REPORTER -->

+<form id="gallery_approve" method="post" action="{S_GALLERY_APPROVE_ACTION}">

+		<div class="panel-body">
+			<!-- IF U_OVERVIEW -->

+			</div>
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+			<!-- IF .image_unapproved -->
+				<div class="topiclist cplist missing-column responsive-show-all">
+					<table class="footable table table-striped table-primary table-hover footable-loaded tablet">
+						<thead>
+							<tr>
+								<th data-class="expand" class="footable-visible footable-first-column">{L_GALLERY_MCP_QUEUE_DETAIL}</th>
+								<th data-hide="phone" class="footable-visible">Tópico&nbsp;{L_ALBUM}</th>
+								<th data-hide="phone" class="footable-visible footable-last-column">Marcar</th>
+							</tr>
+						</thead>
+						<tbody>
+							<!-- BEGIN image_unapproved -->
+							<tr>
+								<td class="expand footable-visible footable-first-column">
+									<div class="list-inner">
+										<span style="display: inline; float: left;">
+											<a href="{image_unapproved.U_IMAGE_MODERATE_URL}"><img class="img-responsive" style="max-width: 70px; max-height: 70px;" src="{image_unapproved.U_IMAGE}" alt="{image_unapproved.U_IMAGE_NAME}"></a>
+										</span>
+										<span style="margin-left: 10px;">
+											<a href="{image_unapproved.U_IMAGE_MODERATE_URL}" class="topictitle">{image_unapproved.U_IMAGE_NAME}</a><br />
+											<span style="margin-left: 10px; vertical-align: middle;">{L_UPLOADED_BY_USER}{L_COLON} {image_unapproved.IMAGE_AUTHOR} &raquo; {image_unapproved.IMAGE_TIME}</span>
+										</span>
+									</div>
+								</td>
+								<td class="footable-visible">
+									<div class="moderation">
+										<span>
+											{L_ALBUM}{L_COLON} <a href="{image_unapproved.IMAGE_ALBUM_URL}">{image_unapproved.IMAGE_ALBUM}</a>
+										</span>
+									</div>
+								</td>
+								<td class="footable-visible footable-last-column">
+									<input name="approval[{image_unapproved.IMAGE_ALBUM_ID}][]" value="{image_unapproved.U_IMAGE_ID}" type="checkbox">
+								</td>
+							</tr>
+							<!-- END image_unapproved -->
+						</tbody>
+					</table>
+			<!-- ELSE -->
+				<p> {L_NO_WAITING_UNAPPROVED_IMAGE}
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+			</div>
+		</div>

+			<div class="space10"></div>
+			<div class="input-group-btn">

+				<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="marklist('gallery_approve', 'approval', false); return false;" class="btn btn-default" title="{L_UNMARK_ALL}"><i class="fa fa-square-o"></i></a>

+
+		<!-- ENDIF -->
+	</form>

+					{L_STATUS}{L_COLON} <span style="font-weight: bold;">{STATUS}</span>
+				</p>
+
+				<div class="content">
+					<div style="text-align: center;">{UC_IMAGE}</div>

+						{IMAGE_DESC}

+
+			<span class="corners-bottom"><span></span></span></div>
+		</div>
+
+		<!-- IF .reports -->

+					<p class="author">{L_REPORT_BY} {reports.REPORTER} &raquo; {reports.REPORT_TIME}</p>

+					<!-- ENDIF -->

+			</div>
+		<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+		<form method="post" action="{S_MCP_ACTION}">

+				<input class="button2" type="submit" value="{L_SUBMIT}" />
+				<input type="hidden" value="{REPORT_ID}" name="image_id_ary[{REPORT_ID}]" />
+			</fieldset>
+		</form>
+		</div>
+	<div class="clear"></div>
+
+	</div>

+</div>

+<!-- IF S_GALLERY_FEEDS --><link rel="alternate" type="application/atom+xml" title="{L_FEED} - {L_GALLERY}" href="{U_GALLERY_FEED}" /><!-- ENDIF -->

+<link rel="stylesheet" href="{S_GP_HIGHSLIDE}highslide.css" />
+<script>
+	hs.graphicsDir = '{S_GP_HIGHSLIDE}graphics/';
+	hs.align = 'center';
+	hs.transitions = ['expand', 'crossfade'];
+	hs.fadeInOut = true;
+	hs.dimmingOpacity = 0.8;
+	hs.outlineType = 'rounded-white';
+	hs.captionEval = 'this.thumb.title';
+	// This value needs to be set to false, to solve the issue with the highly increasing view counts.
+	hs.continuePreloading = false;
+
+	// Add the slideshow providing the controlbar and the thumbstrip
+	hs.addSlideshow({
+		interval: 5000,
+		repeat: false,
+		useControls: true,
+		fixedControls: 'fit',
+		overlayOptions: {
+			opacity: .75,
+			position: 'top center',
+			hideOnMouseOut: true
+		}
+	});
+</script>

+<script>
+	if (window.addEventListener) {
+		window.addEventListener("load",initLytebox,false);
+	} else if (window.attachEvent) {
+		window.attachEvent("onload",initLytebox);
+	} else {
+		window.onload = function() {initLytebox();}
+	}
+	function initLytebox() {
+		var imgMaxWidth = 1280;
+		var imgWarning = '';
+		myLytebox = new LyteBox(imgMaxWidth, imgWarning);
+	}

+<script>
+head.ready(function () {
+var gallery_popup_window = false;
+var current_active_message = 0;
+
+function set_text_field(id)
+{
+	current_active_message = id
+	text_name = 'message_' + id;
+
+	if (gallery_popup_window)
+	{
+		gallery_popup_window.text_name = 'message_' + id;
+	}
+}
+
+var same_name = false;
+
+function change_read_write()
+{
+	same_name = document.getElementById('same_name').checked;
+	if (!same_name)
+	{
+		<!-- BEGIN image -->
+			<!-- IF not image.S_FIRST_ROW -->
+		make_writable('{image.S_ROW_COUNT}')
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+		<!-- END image -->
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		update_all('message');
+		update_all('image_name');
+		<!-- BEGIN image -->
+			<!-- IF not image.S_FIRST_ROW -->
+		make_readonly('{image.S_ROW_COUNT}');
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+		<!-- END image -->
+		set_text_field(0);
+	}
+}
+
+function make_readonly(image) {
+	var element;
+
+	// Message field
+	element = document.getElementById('message_' + image);
+	element.readOnly = true;
+	add_class(element, 'readonly');
+
+	// Image name
+	element = document.getElementById('image_name_' + image);
+	element.readOnly = true;
+	add_class(element, 'readonly');
+
+	// Description length note
+	element = document.getElementById('desc_length_' + image);
+	element.style.display = 'none';
+}
+
+function make_writable(image) {
+	var element;
+
+	// Message field
+	element = document.getElementById('message_' + image);
+	element.readOnly = false;
+	remove_class(element, 'readonly');
+
+	// Image name
+	element = document.getElementById('image_name_' + image);
+	element.readOnly = false;
+	remove_class(element, 'readonly');
+
+	// Description length note
+	element = document.getElementById('desc_length_' + image);
+	element.style.display = 'block';
+}
+
+function update_all(what)
+{
+	if (same_name)
+	{
+		var content = document.getElementById(what + '_0').value;
+		var count = 0;
+		if (parseInt(document.getElementById('image_num').value))
+		{
+			count = parseInt(document.getElementById('image_num').value);
+		}
+		<!-- BEGIN image -->
+			<!-- IF not image.S_FIRST_ROW -->
+		document.getElementById(what + '_{image.S_ROW_COUNT}').value = content.split('{' + 'NUM' + '}').join(({image.S_ROW_COUNT} + count));
+			<!-- ENDIF -->
+		<!-- END image -->
+	}
+}
+
+function has_class(ele, cls) {
+	return ele.className.match(new RegExp('(\\s|^)' + cls + '(\\s|$)'));
+}
+
+function add_class(ele, cls) {
+	if (!this.has_class(ele, cls))
+	{
+		ele.className += " " + cls;
+	}
+}
+
+function remove_class(ele, cls)
+{
+	if (has_class(ele, cls))
+	{
+		var reg = new RegExp('(\\s|^)' + cls + '(\\s|$)');
+		ele.className = ele.className.replace(reg,' ');
+	}
+}
+
+/**
+* Window popup
+* Based on the function of phpBB.
+* Just storing the return of window.open(),
+* so we can set the text_name in the popup aswell.
+*/
+function gallery_popup(url, width, height, name)
+{
+	if (!name)
+	{
+		name = '_popup';
+	}
+
+	gallery_popup_window = window.open(url.replace(/&amp;/g, '&'), name, 'height=' + height + ',resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes, width=' + width);
+
+	/**
+	* Update the value of text_name when the window got opened...
+	* We use a 0.5 second timeout here, so the browser got the popup open, before we try to set the field.
+	* Hopefully users on super-fast computers, are not too fast in selecting the smilies.
+	*/
+	setTimeout("set_text_field(current_active_message)", 500);
+
+	return false;
+}
+});
+</script>

+<!-- INCLUDE gallery/gallery_header.html -->
+<div class="side-segment"><h3><a href="{S_ALBUM_ACTION}">{IMAGE_NAME}</a></h3></div>
+
+<div class="clearfix">

+			<i class="icon-warning-sign"></i> 
+			<a href="{U_IMAGE_REPORTED}">{L_IMAGE_REPORTED}</a>
+		</div>
+	<!-- ENDIF -->
+
+	<div class="panel thumbnail center-block vertical-center"<!-- IF S_STATUS_UNAPPROVED --> style="position:relative;border-color:#daa520;border-width:3px;"<!-- ENDIF -->>
+		<ul style="display:table;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;width:100%;list-style: none;">
+		<!-- IF UC_PREV_IMAGE --><li class="previous" style="display: table-cell;vertical-align: middle;">{UC_PREV_IMAGE}</li><!-- ENDIF -->
+		<!-- IF UC_IMAGE_ACTION --><li><a style="padding: 5px 5px;border-radius: 5px;max-width: 85%;" href="{UC_IMAGE_ACTION}"><!-- ENDIF --><img src="{UC_IMAGE}" alt="{IMAGE_NAME}" class="postimage"/><!-- IF UC_IMAGE_ACTION --></a></li><!-- ENDIF -->
+		<!-- IF UC_NEXT_IMAGE --><li class="next vertical-center"  style="display: table-cell;vertical-align: middle;">{UC_NEXT_IMAGE}</li><!-- ENDIF -->
+		</ul>

+			<span style="position:absolute;background:#daa520;color:#fff;top:24px;right:24px;font-family:'Asap Condensed';border-radius:5px;padding:8px;font-size:large;">{L_IMAGE_NOT_APPROVED}</span>
+		<!-- ENDIF -->
+	</div>
+	<div class="space10"></div>
+</div>
+
+<div id="details" class="well well-small">

+	
+<div class="col-md-3 text-center hidden-xs hidden-sm nightpanel" id="profile_poster">
+	<div class="panel-body user-profile-sep">
+	<div class="clearfix">
+		<div class="avatar-over avatar-viewtopic">
+		<!-- IF POSTER_AVATAR -->
+			<!-- IF U_POSTER --><a href="{U_POSTER}">{POSTER_AVATAR}</a><!-- ELSE -->{POSTER_AVATAR}<!-- ENDIF -->
+		<!-- ENDIF -->

diff --git "[FORUM_EXT]/phpbbgallery\\core/styles/all/template/js/gallery_polaroid.js" "[FORUM_EXT]/phpbbgallery\\core/styles/all/template/js/gallery_polaroid.js"
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ "[FORUM_EXT]/phpbbgallery\\core/styles/all/template/js/gallery_polaroid.js"
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+$(document).ready(function() {
+	/**
+	 * Function to resize albums
+	 */
+	function resize() {
+		$('.albums').each(function() {
+			var $this = $(this),
+				albums = $this.children(),
+				maxWidth = Math.floor($this.width()),
+				lastPosition = 0,
+				lastRow = [],
+				maxHeight = 0,
+				nextPosition = 0;
+
+			// Reset all albums
+			albums.removeClass('first-item').css('min-height', '');
+
+			albums.each(function(i) {
+				var item = $(this),
+					left = Math.floor(item.offset().left);
+
+				if (i > 0 && left <= nextPosition) {
+					// Align last row
+					if (lastRow.length) {
+						albums.filter(lastRow.join(',')).css('min-height', maxHeight + 'px');
+					}
+
+					// Clear row
+					item.addClass('first-item');
+
+					// Reset counters
+					left = 0;
+					lastFirst = i;
+					maxHeight = 0;
+					lastRow = [];
+				}
+
+				lastRow.push(':nth-child(' + (i + 1) + ')');
+				lastPosition = left;
+				nextPosition = left + item.width() - 1;
+				maxHeight = Math.max(maxHeight, item.height());	
+			});
+		});
+	}
+	resize();
+	$(window).resize(resize);
+});
\ No newline at end of file
